description: Use when competing in a CTF web challenge, practicing in a lab, or testing a web application you are authorized to test. Covers the web challenge workflow, mapping routes and inputs, reading client-side JavaScript for hidden endpoints, exploiting SQL injection, server-side template injection, JWT weaknesses, command injection, file inclusion, and insecure deserialization to capture flags. Use when a challenge gives you a URL, when source code is provided for a web app, or when you need a systematic path from recon to flag in an authorized setting.
